reason: I like asking Claude about my portfolio, but I still press the buttons myself, and a cartoon pet moving my retirement money feels like a toy, not a tool. With no broker named, no price and only demo money so far, I'm not paying or even signing up for the paid plan yet.
objection: Handing an AI permission to trade and pay with my real money when I don't know which broker holds it, who is liable if it makes a bad call, and the whole thing is dressed up as a Tamagotchi.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a few months of seeing its demo decisions beat or match what I'd have done myself, with a serious no-pet view.
